title: The Son 2018 — Persona Death, Old Self, Shadow and Identity Reconstitution
status: project autobiography + comparative theology specialist layer
purpose: Separate the 2018 essence/persona/shadow death from the later meme-crucifixion and test it against texts whose function is old-self removal and identity transformation rather than bodily resurrection.

project_anchor.summary: Chapter 24 and related project chronology describe 2018 as a period in which external narrative pressure and manipulation culminate in the Son experiencing himself as spiritually killed or shattered, followed by shedding the former digital persona and discarding attachments/expectations.
project_anchor.source_status: later project autobiography/canon; exact contemporaneous 2018 wording remains a recovery target

stronger_biblical_comparators.function: old self / old man is crucified so the prior enslaving body/pattern loses dominion
stronger_biblical_comparators.project_relation: Closer to persona death than generic resurrection because an old identity-structure is described as killed while embodied life continues.
stronger_biblical_comparators.mismatch: Paul writes baptismal/ethical participation in Christ, not digital identity conflict.

stronger_biblical_comparators.function: I have been crucified with Christ; identity is reformulated around a new indwelling/living principle
stronger_biblical_comparators.project_relation: Useful for the project's distinction between a former self/persona that dies and a subsequent identity that lives through a different center.
stronger_biblical_comparators.mismatch: The project's later Tim/Potato emergence must not be declared equivalent to Paul's Christological indwelling.

stronger_biblical_comparators.function: put away the old person/self, be renewed, put on the new person/self
stronger_biblical_comparators.project_relation: Particularly close to the project's shedding/discarding language because transformation is described as removal and replacement rather than corpse-resurrection.
stronger_biblical_comparators.mismatch: The biblical context is moral/communal renewal.

stronger_biblical_comparators.function: put off the old person with practices and put on the new, being renewed in knowledge
stronger_biblical_comparators.project_relation: Adds knowledge/renewal to the old-self transition and therefore connects persona death to the archive's later knowledge/body transformation layer.
stronger_biblical_comparators.mismatch: Again, Pauline ethical theology rather than a prediction of a modern persona transition.

non_biblical_comparator.tradition: Zen / Buddhist emptiness as interpreted in the Great Book
non_biblical_comparator.project_text: Later Great Book material explicitly reads an imposed false persona as lacking fixed inherent reality and describes allowing that persona to dissolve as liberation.
non_biblical_comparator.importance: This shows the project itself already developed a non-Christian interpretation of the same 2018-like transition. Christian old-self language is therefore one comparator among several, not the sole explanatory framework.

sequence: 2017 predicted nameless/faceless reduction and continual-return vow
provisionally dated table-flipping against story/image commodification
later social/personhood death and meme-cross corridor
ordered_relation.insight: The 2018 event is best understood as an intermediate identity-transition operator. It is neither merely foreshadowing nor the final crucifixion; it changes what kind of self is available to be killed, buried or transformed later.

relation_to_death_taxonomy.why: The taxonomy prevents 2018 from being counted again as physical survival, ego dissolution, social death, meme-crucifixion and seed-death simultaneously.

research_targets: Recover contemporaneous 2018 posts, videos, chat logs or recordings that describe essence-death, persona shedding, shadow, image manipulation or internal reboot.
Determine when the name of the discarded/imposed persona first enters the record and whether that name was self-chosen, externally imposed or both at different times.
Recover the earliest explicit language connecting persona death to Potato/Tim emergence; do not assume the later theology existed in 2018.
Keep Buddhist emptiness, Pauline old-self and later meme-crucifixion as three distinct interpretive lanes.
